lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Honestly,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I don't know what's wrong with people.
What's the matter?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: They are always wanting to spray me with water.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Thank goodness for the drying function of my clothes,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: or I'd be walking around all day soaked from head to toe.
Hmm...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Is that all you have to say?
Maybe the fact that you have that function is what makes people want to spray you with water.
Maybe people get a kick out of how flustered you get.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: A fair observation,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: but if I walk around without my uniform,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: surely this clothing is a bit too promiscuous?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It wouldn't be nice for me to keep walking around in public like that.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Ugh,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: this is all such a headache.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I can't do anything about that.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: These clothes have been donated to me,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: so I want to wear them and show my gratitude,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: but they're so revealing...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's almost more of a headache than it's worth.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Perhaps I could

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: purchase another swimsuit with my own money?
That's not an option.
I don't think that will change much.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: How come?
Because I don't want this swimsuit of yours to go.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Subordinate,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I've never seen this side of you before.
Please don't get rid of this swimsuit.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I still don't quite understand why you're acting this way, but I'll take that as an order.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Why not?
I'd rather not say it out loud.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: You saying that only makes me more curious.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I won't force you to say anything you don't want to, but I really would like to know.
... You have a fantastic body, so it doesn't matter what type of swimsuit you wear.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That's enough!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I can't text anymore. Too flustered.
So what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I can't change into another swimsuit,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: and people aren't going to stop drenching me with water, no matter how many times I dry myself off.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I just need to learn to put up with it I guess.
Just think about how happy the rest of them are, thanks to you.
Sorry that you have to go through this.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Must you say such strange things,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Subordinate?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Even if there really are people

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: who derive pleasure from spraying me with water,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I find such conduct rather unbecoming of adults.
Fair enough.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I appreciate your sympathy.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Anchor and Mast are always poking fun at me

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: because of this,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: and I was hoping that you'd be different.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Anyway, while we're on this topca-qerpi[j1#%(!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Agh!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Anchor just sprayed water on me!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'll be back in a moment.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I'm going to go after her.
What are you going to do to her?
Helm is no longer replying.
